content: Keeping a secret from a friend can harm trust and create emotional distance. It may lead to feelings of betrayal or isolation if discovered. Honesty, even when difficult, often strengthens relationships. Consider the impact of secrecy on your friendship and whether transparency might be a healthier choice.
